title: Memo: Mark Zuckerberg launches Meta Small Business, a company-wide priority to support entrepreneurship and drive AI use, led by Dina Powell McCormick and more (Axios)
summary: Axios: Memo: Mark Zuckerberg launches Meta Small Business, a company-wide priority to support entrepreneurship and drive AI use, led by Dina Powell McCormick and more — - Zuckerberg asks product managers, designers, engineers and other employees to reach out if they want to work on the new effort.
